verdict.rationale: The evidence documents provider failover, provider ordering and sorting, per-request BYOK credentials, and spend budgets. None of these is rate-limit smoothing. There is no documented pooling or spreading of traffic across multiple keys, and no request queuing or throttling. Per-request BYOK credentials are only a building block a developer could use to rotate keys manually, and failover belongs to a separate resilience story.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can smooth provider rate limits by spreading traffic across keys and queuing or throttling requests
